title: Tenny Madis, Stefi Aludo relish Asian Games debut despite second round exit
summary: Young Filipina tennis players Tenny Madis and Stefi Aludo are taking with them the lessons they learned at the Asian Games, after ending their women's doubles campaign on Wednesday.
